name: @open-adms/back-office
description: Open ADMS back office web app and read-only viewer portal (React + Vite, ARCHITECTURE §14).

scripts.e2e: tsc --build && vite build && pnpm build:world && playwright install --only-shell chromium && (playwright test; screens=$?; playwright test --config playwright.mission.config.ts; mission=$?; [ $screens -eq 0 ] && [ $mission -eq 0 ])
